philosophy.title: More Than Medicine
philosophy.description: True healing happens when we address the whole person—their mind, environment, relationships, and potential. Our collaborative approach ensures no one walks this path alone.

pillar1.title: Family Partnership
pillar1.body: Healing is stronger with support. We help families and loved ones understand the process and participate with confidence.

pillar2.title: Community Connections
pillar2.body: Connection creates momentum. We guide patients toward communities and activities that nurture purpose and belonging.

pillar3.title: Care Team Coordination
pillar3.body: Integrated care matters. We work closely with therapists, physicians, schools, and specialists to keep treatment aligned.

pillar4.title: Social Services Resources
pillar4.body: Wellness depends on stability. We help access practical resources that support daily life and long-term progress.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Families Choose Us
whyChooseUs.description: Because exceptional care should be timely, personal, and connected to every part of a person's life.

item1.title: Same-Day Response
item1.body: Calls returned promptly, almost always on the same day.

item2.title: Appointments Within One Week
item2.body: Timely access to care when families need it most.

item3.title: Holistic Approach
item3.body: Whole-person care tailored to each person's needs.

item4.title: Specialist Referrals
item4.body: Referrals to trusted diagnostic partners and therapists.

item5.title: School Coordination
item5.body: Collaboration with schools and agencies to support student wellbeing and success.
